rows.acceptance: Compare one identical finite specification against TLC first; pin Apalache and solver versions, config, bounds, and counterexample replay. Reject it if it adds no falsification reach beyond TLC.
rows.trigger: TLC measured state-space/model limitation

rows.acceptance: Retain the local toolchain pin and build with trust restrictions; for each theorem record exact statement, imports, admitted axioms, `sorry` audit, and the empirical mapping that remains outside Lean.
rows.trigger: One selected Step/Learn mechanism has an explicit formal contract

rows.acceptance: Do not add until a preregistered theorem-search study exists. Then pin LeanDojo-v2, Pantograph, Lean/mathlib, theorem corpus cutoff, model, prompt, retry/budget policy, and held-out theorem split; report accepted kernel proofs separately from search success.
rows.trigger: Measured proof-search bottleneck on pinned Lean/mathlib

rows.acceptance: On one real HSWM literature question, resolve exact works, deduplicate versions, inspect originals and updates, preserve source URLs/access dates; metadata and citation counts never adjudicate truth.
rows.trigger: One explicit HSWM mechanism or bridge literature question

rows.acceptance: Preserve source hashes, directional relation identity, authority, mapping loss and paired query answers. New catalog references must resolve to declared source records; external live UID references retain explicit NOT_FOUND/NOT_CHECKED status where applicable, and ambiguous or incorrect identities are refused when unique resolution is required by the selected contract.
rows.trigger: This source-bound research catalog

rows.acceptance: Write a source-bound finite abstraction with explicit abstraction loss, state bounds, invariants, fairness assumptions, and reproducible TLC configuration; independently relate any discovered trace to the TypeScript Effect transition semantics.
rows.trigger: An unresolved concurrency/recovery invariant with explicit state variables

rows.acceptance: Create a synthetic randomized HSWM-like data-generating process with known estimand; pin library/graph algorithms; confirm the DAG, treatment timing, unit, SUTVA/interference policy, identification output, placebo/subset/unobserved-confounding refuters, and calculation against an independent implementation.
rows.trigger: Preregistered causal model for selected mechanism

rows.acceptance: Use only after DoWhy identifies the estimand and a power plan supports heterogeneity. Pin estimator/nuisance models/cross-fitting/random seed; preregister effect modifiers and sensitivity analysis; compare against a simple randomized paired estimator.
rows.trigger: Sufficient repeated data and a preregistered heterogeneous-effect question

rows.acceptance: Keep the existing 0.3.260 pin; add one source-bound held-out-task integration only after model/provider identity, seed policy, scorer determinism, log custody, and leakage controls are declared. Pin any Inspect Evals task revision separately because upstream scorer changes can move results.
rows.trigger: Selected next fresh-task study

rows.acceptance: Retain the local toolchain pin and build with trust restrictions; for each theorem record exact statement, imports, admitted axioms, `sorry` audit, and the empirical mapping that remains outside Lean.
rows.trigger: One selected Step/Learn mechanism has an explicit formal contract

rows.acceptance: Pin harness, task YAML, dataset revision, tokenizer/template, decoding parameters, model revision, and scoring patch level; require held-out task suitability review and no use as a proxy for causal learning.
rows.trigger: A declared static capability regression question

rows.acceptance: Do a local-only, read-only export pilot against one existing non-sensitive run. Pin version/backend/artifact URI; prove run IDs, parameter values, source commit and hashes round-trip into KG without secret leakage.
rows.trigger: Measured multi-run tracking/retrieval burden

rows.acceptance: Verify selected trace/span correlation, bounded attributes and actual collector readback; keep raw bodies/private outputs out of public KG.
rows.trigger: Selected experiment execution

rows.acceptance: Defer until sufficient repeated outcomes exist. Then preregister model, priors, diagnostics thresholds, posterior predictive checks, code/data hashes, and a parallel randomization/frequentist analysis; do not use a favorable posterior model as a substitute for a causal design.
rows.trigger: Preregistered likelihood/prior/unit model and sufficient repeated observations

rows.acceptance: Keep the existing 0.3.260 pin; add one source-bound held-out-task integration only after model/provider identity, seed policy, scorer determinism, log custody, and leakage controls are declared. rows.trigger: Selected next fresh-task study

rows.acceptance: Choose a task family only after the estimand and source cutoff are fixed; pin the standard revision, image digest, external-service policy, scorer tests, and bridge revision; verify no HSWM state crosses reset boundaries.
rows.trigger: Selected task conforms to METR Task Standard

rows.acceptance: Validate exact RunEvent2.0.2 and custom facet mapping, START/terminal identity and retries; test ingestion only for a named external integration.
rows.trigger: A named external executor or consumer needs terminal events

Keep protected/private state outside public crates.
